Message:
[XFS] Fix char size overflow in bmap_alloc call for unwritten extent
conversion.

Since bma.conv is a char and XFS_BMAPI_CONVERT is 0x1000, bma.conv was
always assigned zero. Spotted by the GNU C compiler (SVN version).
